knn.calibration: the 99th percentile over the VAL field store's own fit-pool requests, max over seeds, rounded up to 2 dp; ⛔ set on VALID DATA ONLY, before any invalid row was scored with it
knn.length_scale: ⛔ the ATOMS' OWN median nearest-neighbour spacing -- the length scale the admission gate died on. It is here as a RIVAL and no claim of this hub uses it.

lace_energy.why: spoke A does not expose LACE as a callable: its output is a stochastic draw, not a function of the request, so an energy cannot be evaluated on my requests. ⛔ A declared NOT-RUN is never a null.

cont_mlp.footnote: ⛔ DASH. This rival is a GENERATOR: its call returns features plus an out_of_range flag and it has no mechanism by which it could decline a request. On a refusal row it IS `accept_everything` and scores 0 by construction. ⛔ A dash is never a win for us.

like_for_like.verdict: NOT like-for-like: this rival fitted rows carrying a value you hold out, so a row-2/row-5 comparison against a value-holdout arm flatters this rival. Report it with a population footnote or refit on your own pool.

cont_mlp.population_caveat: fitted on the Montero combination pool, which contains EVERY factor value. NOT like-for-like with a value-holdout arm on rows 2 and 5 - call load_rival(...).like_for_like({factor: [values]}) to check.

lace.NOT_RUN: 'lace': LACE's output is a SAMPLER DRAW, not a function of the request alone: two calls on the same request return different features by construction. It is therefore not offered as a request->features callable. Its categorical head also has a closed vocabulary over the realised grid, so it cannot express an off-grid value at all - a structural limit of the method, documented at chlu.core.gen_request.DenseRequests, not one this spoke imposed. Hubs needing LACE on their own corners should ask this spoke to score those corners.
lace.footnote: ⛔ DECLARED NOT RUN, never a null: spoke A does not expose this arm as a callable (its output is a stochastic draw, not a function of the request), so its energy cannot be evaluated on my requests.
